title: Was so exhausted I legitamately went through all of today thinking it...
transcript: Welcome to the great theatre Adventure Day 9. Another day of trying to see as much theatre as possible. And today we're headed to New York. After getting no sleep in the airport and an hour of sleep on the plane, I was exhausted. But instead of resting like a normal person, I headed straight to Bryant Park for the Broadway in Bryant Park series. For four Thursdays every summer, they do a free concert in Bryant Park featuring Broadway shows, and I love this concert every year. It's a really great way to see some of the standbys perform, to experience songs from new and long running and even sometimes upcoming Broadway shows. If you haven't been to one yet, there is one more happening next Thursday. And the reason I came back to New York was just to go to Broadway Con. So I had no shows planned this entire weekend because I was so exhausted. I knew I wanted to see something short, so I headed to Joe's Pub for a concert of new songs from picnic at Hanging Rock, an in development piece all about these three girls and their teacher who go missing during a school hike. And with a cast featuring Lorna Kourtney, Helen Sheen and Katrina Link, it was definitely worth staying up a little longer, but afterwards it was finally time to go rest. See you tomorrow for the first full day of Broadway Con.
